edits.label: add lang+copy
edits.find:
import { Clock3, Sun, CalendarDays, Repeat, CalendarRange, Wallet } from "@lucide/astro";
---

edits.label: translate fields
edits.find:
<label class="field-label" for="period">I'm entering</label>
      <select id="period" class="field-select">
        <option value="annual">Annual Salary</option>
        <option value="hourly">Hourly Rate</option>
      </select>
      <CalculatorField id="amount" label="Amount" type="number" required={true} helpText="Enter the hourly rate or annual salary." />
      <CalculatorField id="hoursPerWeek" label="Hours per Week" type="number" helpText="Default: 40" />
      <CalculatorField id="weeksPerYear" label="Weeks per Year" type="number" helpText="Default: 52" />
      <CalculatorActions calculateId="calculateBtn" resetId="resetBtn" copyId="copyBtn" showCopy={true} />
edits.replace:
<label class="field-label" for="period">{copy.periodLabel}</label>
      <select id="period" class="field-select">
        <option value="annual">{copy.annualOpt}</option>
        <option value="hourly">{copy.hourlyOpt}</option>
      </select>
      <CalculatorField id="amount" label={copy.amount} type="number" required={true} helpText={copy.amountHelp} />
      <CalculatorField id="hoursPerWeek" label={copy.hoursPerWeek} type="number" helpText={copy.hoursPerWeekHelp} />
      <CalculatorField id="weeksPerYear" label={copy.weeksPerYear} type="number" helpText={copy.weeksPerYearHelp} />
      <CalculatorActions calculateId="calculateBtn" resetId="resetBtn" copyId="copyBtn" showCopy={true} calculateText={copy.calculate} resetText={copy.reset} copyText={copy.copy} />

edits.label: EmptyState+Results+about
edits.find:
About this Calculator

Converts gross pay between hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly and annual figures. For net pay after tax, use the country-specific Take-Home Pay Calculator.
edits.replace:
{copy.aboutTitle}

{copy.aboutText}

edits.label: wire calcLang
edits.replace:
<script define:vars={{ calcLang: lang }}>
  window.calcLang = calcLang;
</script>
<script>
  import "../../scripts/regional-salary-calculator";
</script>

edits.label: add lang
translate subtitle + summary
edits.find:
setSubtitle("annualResult", "gross, before tax");

  lastSummary = `Salary Conversion Summary\n\n` +
    `Hourly: ${formatCurrency(r.hourly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Daily: ${formatCurrency(r.daily, "USD")}\n` +
    `Weekly: ${formatCurrency(r.weekly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Biweekly: ${formatCurrency(r.biweekly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Monthly: ${formatCurrency(r.monthly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Annual: ${formatCurrency(r.annual, "USD")}\n`;
edits.replace:
setSubtitle("annualResult", lang === "es" ? "bruto, antes de impuestos" : "gross, before tax");

  lastSummary = lang === "es" ? (
    `Resumen de Conversión de Salario\n\n` +
    `Por Hora: ${formatCurrency(r.hourly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Diario: ${formatCurrency(r.daily, "USD")}\n` +
    `Semanal: ${formatCurrency(r.weekly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Quincenal: ${formatCurrency(r.biweekly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Mensual: ${formatCurrency(r.monthly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Anual: ${formatCurrency(r.annual, "USD")}\n`
  ) : (
    `Salary Conversion Summary\n\n` +
    `Hourly: ${formatCurrency(r.hourly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Daily: ${formatCurrency(r.daily, "USD")}\n` +
    `Weekly: ${formatCurrency(r.weekly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Biweekly: ${formatCurrency(r.biweekly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Monthly: ${formatCurrency(r.monthly, "USD")}\n` +
    `Annual: ${formatCurrency(r.annual, "USD")}\n`
  );
